question: When do differentiated entities become non-different?
premises: Entities can become capable of admitting a share of Bhairava-awareness.
When that happens, their separate essence melts away.
With the loss of separate essence, they become non-different.
inference: Entities become non-different to the extent that they can receive Bhairava-awareness and their separate essence dissolves.
plain_english: To the extent that entities become capable of receiving a share of Bhairava-awareness, their own separate essence melts away and they become non-different by themselves.
